newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Inner Mongolia retailer to list in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Inner Mongolia retailer to list in Shenzhen.

text.p: Retailer Inner Mongolia National Market (Group) Co Ltd will list 16 million A shares on the Shenzhen stock exchange on October 8, a company statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Friday.

The shares were issued at 6.48 yuan per share last month. Proceeds were being used to refurbish the company's flagship department store in Huhhot, capital of Inner Mongolia, and to set up a shopping arcade in Guangzhou, it said.
The company will on the same day list 2.5 million staff shares, which were issued at a face value of one yuan in 1992, the statement said.
The company was once called Inner Mongolia Minzu Department Store Co Ltd.
The statement forecast the company's post-tax profit at 25.91 million yuan for 1996, up from 17.91 million yuan in 1995 and 16.48 million yuan in 1994.
The comnpany has 71.37 million outstanding shares. The state owns 35.64 million, institutions 7.78 million and staff members 11.96 million in addition to the 16 million A shares.
